text: IMF staff assess the FY2025 fiscal stance as appropriately tight to achieve public debt of 50 percent of GDP or less by 2030, with public debt assessed as sustainable with high probability. A primary fiscal surplus of 1.1 percent in 2024 and 1.1 percent of GDP in FY2025 is expected. Staff consider the broadly neutral monetary policy stance appropriate, recommending a data-dependent approach. Staff highlight risks from tourism competition, bank interest rate spreads, and central bank balance sheet vulnerabilities.
